closes_7.name: Body-Scan (universal default)
closes_7.line: That's how it works in general. Want to know how it works in your body? 60-second Body-Scan — link in bio.

closes_7.name: Coached-Not-Preached
closes_7.line: I'm not going to tell you what to do. I'll show you what your body's already doing — then we build the plan around that. Start with the Scan.

closes_7.name: Specificity
closes_7.line: Generic plans fail because they're built for an average person who doesn't exist. Yours won't be. Scan first, plan second.

closes_7.name: Receipt
closes_7.line: Priya, Jersey City, 8 kg in 14 weeks — built on her Scan, not a template. Yours starts at the same place.

closes_7.name: Threshold (tripwire)
closes_7.line: Not ready for coaching? Start where it costs less than a protein tub. Burn & Build — yours for life.

closes_7.name: Comment-Keyword
closes_7.line: Comment SCAN and I'll send the Body-Scan straight to your DMs.

closes_7.name: Professional-Respect
closes_7.line: If you coach or treat people for a living — the Scan's logic is open. Run yourself through it and tell me where I'm wrong.
